[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Gamemodes[/color][/head]
The selected gamemode determines [bold]which factions and jobs are available, which stations and ships spawn, and what kind of round is being played[/bold]. Always check the lobby's selected preset before preparing a character.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Freeplay variants[/color][/head]
Freeplay is the open-ended 2-4 hour sandbox. Trade, patrol, exploration, diplomacy, raids, and war are driven by players and round events. The vote contains several different Freeplay maps:
- [bold]Freeplay[/bold]: the broad multi-faction Adventure preset. - [bold]Freeplay | DSM & NCWL[/bold]: the current default, focused on the two major military powers. - [bold]Freeplay | TFCF & SHI[/bold]: the Federation and Shinohara contest the frontier. - [bold]Freeplay | TAP/Gliess & TFCF[/bold]: the Pact, Gliess interests, and the Federation are active. - [bold]Freeplay | TFCF & SHI (Alternative)[/bold]: the Jackal replaces the Freeport in the TFCF/SHI layout.
[color=#8fc98a]For a first round, use the default DSM/NCWL preset and choose Freeholder or Union Worker.[/color] Other variants may require faction playtime before their main jobs become available. Freeplay respawn time is 10 minutes.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Hyperwar | NCWL vs DSM[/color][/head]
DSM and NCWL fight over the central asteroid belt with the surrounding ring removed. SHI and TFCF are closed. Expect fleet actions, boarding, and ground pushes early in the round. Respawn time is 10 minutes.
[color=#d9776c]This is a war-focused preset, not an OOC deathmatch.[/color] Character roleplay and the [textlink="Roleplay Rules" link="RoleplayRules"] still apply.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Unionfall | NCWL vs DSM[/color][/head]
Unionfall is a scripted battle with its own roster. The NCWL Homeguard aboard the Clementine is intercepted by a DSM punishment regiment aboard the Nemesis.
Standard station jobs are closed. Both sides use dedicated Cadet, Rifleman, Doctor, Officer, Leader, Ship Captain, and Ship Crew roles. Respawn time is 5 minutes.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Planetfall[/color][/head]
Planetfall is a ground-focused scenario in Count Olywier Rabenau's charter. Standard station jobs are closed and the mode uses its own Imperial, MVD, worker, partisan, medical, court, Freeholder, Oathbound, and Levyman roles. Respawn time is 5 minutes.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Rules in every mode[/color][/head]
The gamemode changes the scenario, not the server rules. Even in an immediate war round, remain in character and follow the escalation and round-removal requirements in the [textlink="Roleplay Rules" link="RoleplayRules"].
